description: Use when the user asks only about TLS-RPT (SMTP TLS reporting). Returns the _smtp._tls record and its report addresses, with findings. For MTA-STS use mta_sts, which includes TLS-RPT. Ex: 'Where do TLS reports for example.com go?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.

name: tlsrpt
title: TLS-RPT check
